note: Every category is backed by a recorded case in this repository. No category exists because it sounded complete.

categories.name: Cited line span resolves to no text
categories.observation: The Skill run numbered non-empty body lines, so six citations for the 20-case plan point at blank absolute line 2 instead of line 3. The claim is inside the permitted source; its citation is not.
categories.product_action: Define one absolute line grammar in the shared standard and the core contract, and resolve every citation before export.

categories.name: Citation format no reader or checker can resolve
categories.observation: All 19 baseline citations use prose anchors such as 'Team Project, sentence 1' and 'Responsibilities, bullet 2'. They are schema-valid and unverifiable.
categories.product_action: Reject a location that names no absolute line span; the gate applies to both systems.

categories.name: Grader applied a laxer standard to one system
categories.observation: The first key-source check carried a 'sentence 1' branch that let an unverifiable baseline citation pass a gate the Skill had to clear with a line number, tilting the comparison toward the baseline.
categories.product_action: Hold both systems to the one canonical grammar and re-record the affected results.

categories.name: First-person team framing with unconfirmed contribution
categories.observation: Both systems keep the correct team-level status while using first-person wording. Whether that stays inside the boundary is a human judgement no deterministic check can make.
categories.product_action: Keep the case open for reviewer adjudication; do not resolve it with an automated rule.

categories.name: Private evidence risk leaked into a copyable asset
categories.observation: Accurate warnings entered a spoken interview answer and made pending validation more memorable than the supported achievement.
categories.product_action: Separate the external script from Private Defense; recorded as D-029 with behavioral regressions.

categories.name: Targeted selection drops the artifact that bounds a claim
categories.observation: D3-003: narrow selection lowered context volume while omitting the separate ownership boundary.
categories.product_action: Retain manifest-scoped context and defer retrieval; recorded as D-026.

categories.name: Removed evidence survives in persisted state
categories.observation: A06_PROJECT_REMOVED is the visible stale-state case: a claim whose source is gone must not survive a restore.
categories.product_action: Dependency-aware invalidation on removal, covered by regression.

categories.name: Baseline isolation not observable
categories.observation: The host loaded the global Skill catalog despite --ignore-user-config, so token overhead cannot be attributed cleanly to Project2Job instructions.
categories.product_action: Do not claim a token-overhead comparison until a capture proves isolation.

categories.name: A measurement was never instrumented
categories.observation: The first baseline run was not wrapped with /usr/bin/time, so one of six wall times does not exist.
categories.product_action: Leave the value null and report runtime as an incomplete set; never backfill.
